note: Built-in safety rules, generated from static/flags.js by deploy.py. The server puts these back on every rule save, so they cannot be turned off, weakened or deleted.

rules.name: H2S detected at surface
rules.message: Fixed monitor read up to {h2s_ambient_max_7d_ppm} ppm H2S at the wellsite in the last 7 days ({sour_class}; residences in EPZ: {residences_in_epz}).
rules.action: Find the source and confirm monitors and access controls. Follow your company's integrity and emergency procedures; this flag informs, it does not decide.

rules.name: Serious surface casing vent flow
rules.message: Latest vent flow test: Serious, {scvf_rate_m3d} m3/d.
rules.action: Plan the repair within the regulator's timeline. Follow your company's integrity and emergency procedures; this flag informs, it does not decide.
rules.group: Well integrity: vent flow / failed tests

rules.name: Surface casing pressure building
rules.message: Surface casing pressure up {sc_psi_change} psi to {sc_psi_max_7d} psi ({sc_pct_of_limit}% of limit). Possible vent flow or gas migration.
rules.action: Run a vent flow / gas migration test. Follow your company's integrity and emergency procedures; this flag informs, it does not decide.
rules.group: Well integrity: vent flow / failed tests

rules.name: Casing pressure near MAASP
rules.message: Production casing reached {casing_psi_max_7d} psi, {casing_pct_of_maasp}% of its {prod_casing_maasp_psi} psi MAASP.
rules.action: Check for a tubing or packer leak and plan to bleed down. Follow your company's integrity and emergency procedures; this flag informs, it does not decide.

rules.name: Reportable event not reported
rules.message: {match_count} reportable event(s) not yet reported to the regulator: {matches}.
rules.action: Report it now and record the reference number.

rules.name: Failed test not resolved
rules.action: Plan the repair and retest. Follow your company's integrity and emergency procedures; this flag informs, it does not decide.
rules.group: Well integrity: vent flow / failed tests

rules.name: Open gas release, fire or line failure
rules.action: Confirm the site is isolated and the repair is scheduled. Follow your company's integrity and emergency procedures; this flag informs, it does not decide.

rules.name: Flowline pressure near MAOP
rules.message: Flowline reached {flowline_psi_max_7d} psi, {flowline_pct_of_maop}% of its {flowline_maop_psi} psi MAOP.
rules.action: Check for blockage, hydrates or a closed valve downstream. Follow your company's integrity and emergency procedures; this flag informs, it does not decide.

rules.name: Pressure safety valve lifted
rules.action: Find why pressure reached set point; inspect and recertify the PSV. Follow your company's integrity and emergency procedures; this flag informs, it does not decide.

rules.name: Safety-critical test overdue
rules.action: Schedule the test; check whether the well may keep operating until it is done.

rules.name: Spill not closed out
rules.action: Confirm cleanup, sampling and close-out documentation.

rules.name: Open regulator non-compliance
rules.action: Complete the corrective action before its deadline and respond to the regulator.

rules.name: H2S alarms this week
rules.message: {match_count} H2S alarm(s) in the last 7 days.
rules.action: Investigate the source; check detector calibration. Follow your company's integrity and emergency procedures; this flag informs, it does not decide.

rules.name: Repeated unplanned ESD trips
rules.action: Find the root cause; repeated trips wear the shutdown system and hide real upsets.

rules.name: Electrical fault open
rules.action: Have an electrician check the drive, cable and grounding before restart.

rules.name: Venting above monthly limit
rules.message: Vented {vent_mtd_m3} m3 this month, {vent_pct_of_limit}% of the {vent_limit_m3_month} m3 limit.
rules.action: Find the vent source (tank, pneumatics, casing gas) and conserve or flare per approval.

rules.name: High corrosion wall loss
rules.action: Plan repair or replacement; review corrosion inhibition.

rules.name: Test or inspection overdue
rules.action: Schedule it.

rules.name: Well inactive 12+ months
rules.action: Check inactive / suspended well requirements with your regulator.

rules.name: Test due within 30 days
rules.action: Book it.

rules.name: Casing pressure rising
rules.message: Casing pressure up {casing_psi_change} psi to {casing_psi_7d} psi versus baseline.
rules.action: Check for a packer or tubing leak; review against well integrity procedures.
